principles.fast_discovery: Use current structured feeds/depth charts to detect changes quickly.
principles.factual_confirmation: Prefer NFL/team primary sources for transactions, injury reports and inactives.
principles.local_signal: Maintain per-team credentialed beat sources for practice/coach-role information.
principles.analysis: Fantasy analysts interpret opportunity; they do not independently prove factual injury/transaction status.

activation_rule: Only individually verified primary events plus current functional role evidence and live Sleeper state may activate impact; acquisition/trade decisions additionally require their own evidence gates. No time-pressure exemption.
